verdict.rationale: Temporal exposes a gRPC-based Client API and a full-featured CLI that can start/list workflows, manage namespaces, and administer Cloud resources (temporal-docs-32, temporal-gh-1, temporal-docs-4), and the Web UI itself is just a client of this same API layer. However, there is no documented OpenAPI/REST specification (probe returned 404s for all candidate spec URLs) and no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, leaving AI-native/API-first users without a clearly documented, complete surface. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or spec confirming full UI-to-API parity, a public REST/OpenAPI schema, and independent confirmation that all UI actions (e.g., debugging views, archival configuration) are API-accessible.
